loadTypes.title: Load types
loadTypes.description: The kinds of electrical load a need can have (LED, halogen, motor, …). Channel limits are given per load type.
loadTypes.activeHint: Inactive load types cannot be chosen for new needs.
loadTypes.powerFactorHint: Converts the power of needs (W) into current (A) for limits in A: I = P / (V · power factor). LED about 0.9, motors about 0.7, resistive loads 1.

outputKinds.title: Output kinds
outputKinds.description: The kinds of channel a module supplies (dimmer output, relay output, blind output, …) and the functions they serve.
outputKinds.activeHint: Inactive output kinds cannot be chosen for new fields.
outputKinds.functionTypesHint: The function types a channel of this kind can drive.
outputKinds.alternativeHint: Channels of another kind that together can act as one of this kind, e.g. 2 relay outputs as 1 blind output (fixed pairs 1+2, 3+4, …). A product uses them only where it allows it (meaning "May act as another output kind").
outputKinds.alternativeCountHint: How many of those channels make one of this kind (1–16).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The fields (columns) known across the catalog and what their values mean for the checks. Category attributes and import columns link to them.
fields.keyHint: Lower snake case, e.g. dimmer_outputs. Import columns with this name are matched.
fields.label: Label
fields.unitHint: Shown with the value, e.g. W, mA, TE.
fields.meaningHint: What SnapFlow uses the value for. "Just information" is shown but not checked.
fields.meaningTypes: This meaning needs the value type: {{types}}.
fields.productTypesHint: The meaning applies only to products of these product types; none ticked = all.
fields.lockedHint: Fixed while categories link this field.
fields.loadTypeOptionalHint: Leave at "Any load type" for a limit that applies to every load.
fields.optionsFixed: This meaning needs exactly these choices; their labels can change.

meaning.alternative_allowed: May act as another output kind
